name: RRM Academy Library
description: Low-level read-only MCP for the RRM Academy research library. Corpus stats, single-article lookup by id/slug/pmid/doi, keyword metadata search. Distinct from the high-level RAG MCP at mcp.rrmacademy.org -- this surface is for agents that want raw structured access to library data without semantic search or editorial guardrails.
instructions: Low-level structured access to the RRM Academy research library. Use `library_status` to inspect corpus size and enrichment pipeline state. Use `library_get_article` to retrieve a single article by id, slug, pmid, or doi. Use `library_search_metadata` for keyword (SQL LIKE) search over title/authors/journal/abstract; for semantic search, use the apex mcp.rrmacademy.org MCP instead. All tools are public and read-only.

authentication.description: Public read-only surface. No authentication required for any method. The 3 tools are read-only with no PII; CF edge handles abuse detection.

tools.name: library_status
tools.description: Returns corpus stats for the RRM Academy library: total article count, breakdown by enrichment status (intake / enriching / needs_classification / classified / published / archived), enrichment-stage breakdown, and unresolvable-intake count. Use to assess library size and pipeline health before deeper queries.

tools.name: library_get_article
tools.description: Retrieve a single article by id, slug, pmid, or doi. Returns the full article record (title, authors, year, journal, abstract, doi, pmid, topics, open-access status, classification). Pass exactly one identifier. Returns 404-style error if no match.

tools.name: library_search_metadata
tools.description: Keyword search over published article title, authors, journal, and abstract using SQL LIKE matching. Returns up to 50 article summaries ordered by year descending. Distinct from the apex mcp.rrmacademy.org `search` tool which uses semantic/vector retrieval. Use this when you have specific terms to match exactly (author names, journal titles, specific phrases).

related_servers.name: RRM Academy (apex)
related_servers.description: High-level RAG MCP with semantic search and editorial guardrails. Use for natural-language queries; this server is for structured lookups.
